description:
Monthly Payroll

Three steps a month: do the payroll (the checks list anything missing, then the slips are generated and submitted), pay the salaries (booked, then a payment proposal for the bank file or EBICS), and hand the payslips out: by e-mail, by post with a WebStamp, or printed.
name: Run Your First Swiss Payroll Cycle
title: Run your first monthly payroll
